records.literal_gloss: A miktam of David. Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in you.

en.L: A miktam of David. Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: A miktam of David. Guard me, God, for I have made {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge.
en.R: A song of David. Watch over me, God. I come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety.

fr.L: Un miktam de David. Garde-moi, Dieu, car je me suis réfugié en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Un miktam de David. Protège-moi, Dieu, car j’ai fait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge.
fr.R: Un chant de David. Veille sur moi, Dieu. Je viens me mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Mikitamu ya Daudi. \q Unilinde, Ee Mungu, \q kwa maana nimekimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: Mikitamu ya Daudi. \q Unihifadhi, Ee Mungu, \q kwa maana nimekufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. \q Uniangalie, Mungu. \q Ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili nipate usalama.

es.L: Mictam de David. Guárdame, oh Dios, porque en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he refugiado.
es.B: Mictam de David. Protégeme, oh Dios, porque he hecho de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mi refugio.
es.R: Canto de David. Cuídame, Dios. Vengo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo.

vi.L: [Một] bài Mích-tam của Đa-vít. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, \q xin gìn giữ tôi, vì tôi đã nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bài Mích-tam của Đa-vít. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin canh giữ tôi, \q vì tôi đã lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm nơi ẩn náu.
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin trông chừng tôi. \q Tôi chạy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn.

ko.L: 다윗의 믹담. \q 하나님, 저를 지켜 주십시오. \q 제가 주님께 피하였습니다.
ko.B: 다윗의 믹담. \q 하나님, 저를 지켜 주십시오. \q 제가 주님을 피난처로 삼았습니다.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. \q 하나님, 저를 지켜 주십시오. \q 저는 안전을 찾아 주님께 나아갑니다.

pt.L: Mictão de Davi. Guarda-me, Deus, porque em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me refugiei.
pt.B: Mictão de Davi. Protege-me, Deus, pois fiz de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} o meu refúgio.
pt.R: Canção de Davi. Cuida de mim, Deus. Venho a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em busca de proteção.

am.L: የዳዊት ሚክታም። \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ \q በአንተ ተጠልያለሁና ጠብቀኝ።
am.B: የዳዊት ሚክታም። \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ \q አንተን መጠጊያዬ አድርጌአለሁና ጠብቀኝ።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር። \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ተንከባከበኝ። \q ለደኅንነት ወደ አንተ እመጣለሁ።

hi.L: दाऊद का मिक्ताम। हे परमेश्वर, मेरी रक्षा कर, क्योंकि मैंने तुझमें शरण ली है।
hi.B: दाऊद का मिक्ताम। हे परमेश्वर, मेरी रक्षा कर, क्योंकि मैंने तुझे अपना शरणस्थान बनाया है।
hi.R: दाऊद का गीत। हे परमेश्वर, मेरी देखभाल कर। मैं सुरक्षा के लिए तेरे पास आता हूँ।

ru.L: Михтам Давида. Храни меня, Боже, потому что в {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я укрылся.
ru.B: Михтам Давида. Охраняй меня, Боже, ведь {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я сделал своим прибежищем.
ru.R: Песнь Давида. Береги меня, Боже. Я прихожу к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, чтобы быть в безопасности.

ja.L: ダビデのミクタム。神よ、わたしを守ってください。わたしは、あなたに身を避けたのだから。
ja.B: ダビデのミクタム。神よ、わたしを守ってください。わたしは、あなたを避け所としたのだから。
ja.R: ダビデの歌。神よ、わたしを見守ってください。わたしは、安全を求めて、あなたのもとに逃げ込む。

uk.L: Міктам Давида. Бережи мене, Боже, бо я шукаю притулку в {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}.
uk.B: Міктам Давида. Охороняй мене, Боже, бо я зробив {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} своїм притулком.
uk.R: Пісня Давида. Пильнуй мене, Боже. Я приходжу до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} по захист.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: miktam: a kind of psalm whose meaning is unknown
decisions.reason: The word (miktam) stands at the head of this psalm and of Psalms 56-60. Its meaning is lost; the ancient Greek translation took it as an inscription on a stone, and others link it to a word for gold.

decisions.choice: I have taken refuge: I have run to God for shelter
decisions.reason: As in 7:2 and 11:1.

decisions.choice: A song
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (m2); Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: "miktam" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced); "Un chant" at Readable
decisions.reason: The kind of psalm the word names is unknown (m2), so French keeps it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Mikitamu" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Wimbo" at Readable
decisions.reason: What a miktam was is not known (m2). The word is kept in a Swahili form, as the English keeps it; Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: Mictam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew miktam names a kind of psalm whose meaning is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word in its Spanish form, "mictam"; Readable says "Canto", as the English Readable says "A song".

decisions.choice: "bài Mích-tam" (L, B); "Bài ca" (R)
decisions.reason: No one knows what a miktam was (see the meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the word as a name, in the form the terms note sets, and Readable calls it a song, as the English Readable does. "bài thơ vàng" (golden poem) rests on a guess from the word's sound.

decisions.choice: "믹담" kept as a name (L, B); "노래" at Readable
decisions.reason: The kind of psalm meant is unknown (meaning decision m2); Korean keeps the word as a name, as the English keeps "miktam", and says only "song" at Readable.

decisions.choice: Mictão (L, B); Canção (R)
decisions.reason: The book keeps this unexplained title as a name in Portuguese spelling, "Mictão" (m2); Readable says only that it is a song, as the English does.

decisions.choice: miktam as "ሚክታም", a name; Readable says "መዝሙር" (song), as the English
decisions.reason: The heading table keeps the word, whose meaning is unknown (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.
The meaning of miktam is unknown (m2). Literal and Balanced keep the word, in the form the poetry terms note gives; Readable says only that it is a song, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "तुझमें", "तुझे", "तेरे" to God; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalmist speaks to God with "तू" and of God with honorific forms.

decisions.choice: "Михтам" (L, B); "Песнь" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning of miktam is lost (m2); as the poetry note settles, Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, "михтам", and Readable says only that it is a song, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: miktam "ミクタム" (L, B), "歌" (R), as the Psalter's titles; El "神よ"; the request "守ってください"
decisions.reason: The kind of psalm is unknown (m2), so Literal and Balanced transliterate it as the English does; requests to God are 〜てください in the Psalter.

decisions.choice: "Міктам" transcribed, as the English keeps "miktam"
decisions.reason: The kind of song the word names is unknown; Readable calls it a song, as the English does.

source.text: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You have said to YHWH, My Lord [are] you; my good [is] not beyond you.

en.L: [My soul,] you have said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You [are] my Lord; my good [is] not beyond {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: My soul, you have told {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my Lord; my good is found in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone."
en.R: My soul, you told {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my Lord. All the good I have is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

fr.L: [Mon âme,] tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu [es] mon Seigneur ; mon bonheur n’[est] pas en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.B: Mon âme, tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Seigneur ; mon bonheur, je ne le trouve qu’en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.R: Mon âme, tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Seigneur. Tout le bien que j’ai, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »

sw.L: [Ee nafsi yangu,] umemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe [ni] Bwana wangu; \q mema yangu hayapo nje {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."
sw.B: Nafsi yangu, umemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Bwana wangu; \q mema yangu yanapatikana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} peke yako."
sw.R: Nafsi yangu, ulimwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Bwana wangu. \q Mema yote niliyo nayo ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."

es.L: [Alma mía,] has dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú [eres] mi Señor; mi bien no [está] fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.B: Alma mía, le has dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Señor; mi bien se encuentra solo en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.R: Alma mía, le dijiste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Señor. Todo el bien que tengo eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}».

vi.L: [Hỡi linh hồn tôi,] mình đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài [là] Chúa của tôi; \q phước hạnh của tôi chẳng [có] ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, mình đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là Chúa của tôi; \q điều tốt lành của tôi chỉ ở nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thôi."
vi.R: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, mình đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là Chúa của tôi. \q Mọi điều tốt lành tôi có chính là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: [내 영혼아,] 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 말하였다. \q "주님은 저의 주님이십니다. 저의 선은 주님 밖에 없습니다."
ko.B: 내 영혼아, 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 아뢰었다. "주님은 저의 주님이십니다. \q 저의 행복은 오직 주님께만 있습니다."
ko.R: 내 영혼아, 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 말씀드렸다. "주님은 저의 주님이십니다. \q 제가 가진 좋은 것은 바로 주님이십니다."

pt.L: [Minha alma,] você disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Tu [és] o meu Senhor; o meu bem não [está] além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}."
pt.B: Minha alma, você disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Tu és o meu Senhor; o meu bem está só em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}."
pt.R: Minha alma, você disse {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Tu és o meu Senhor. Todo o bem que eu tenho és {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}."

am.L: [ነፍሴ ሆይ]፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፦ «አንተ ጌታዬ [ነህ]፤ \q መልካምነቴ ከአንተ በላይ አይደለም» አልሽ።
am.B: ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፦ «አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ፤ \q መልካም ነገሬ የሚገኘው በአንተ ብቻ ነው» ብለሻል።
am.R: ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፦ «አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ። \q ያለኝ መልካም ነገር ሁሉ አንተ ነህ» አልሽ።

hi.L: [हे मेरे प्राण,] तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा है, "तू मेरा प्रभु [है]; मेरी भलाई तुझसे बाहर नहीं।"
hi.B: हे मेरे प्राण, तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा है, "तू मेरा प्रभु है; मेरी भलाई केवल तुझमें है।"
hi.R: हे मेरे मन, तुमने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से कहा, "तू मेरा प्रभु है। मेरे पास जो कुछ भला है, वह तू ही है।"

ru.L: [Душа моя,] ты сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Ты — мой Господь; моё благо — не помимо {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.»
ru.B: Душа моя, ты сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Ты — мой Господь; моё благо — только в {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.»
ru.R: Душа моя, ты сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Ты — мой Господь. Всё доброе, что у меня есть, — это {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}.»

ja.L: [わたしの魂よ、]あなたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言った。「あなたはわたしの主。わたしの幸いは、あなたを離れてはない。」
ja.B: わたしの魂よ、あなたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言った。「あなたこそ、わたしの主。わたしの幸いは、ただあなたのうちにある。」
ja.R: わたしの魂よ、あなたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言った。「あなたはわたしの主。わたしにとって良いものは、すべてあなただ。」

uk.L: [Душе моя,] ти сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Ти — мій Господь; моє добро — не поза {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.»
uk.B: Душе моя, ти сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Ти — мій Господь; моє добро — тільки в {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}.»
uk.R: Душе моя, ти сказала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Ти — мій Господь. Усе добро, яке я маю, — це {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}.»

decisions.choice: you have said: the psalmist speaking to himself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "you (feminine) have said", most naturally spoken to the psalmist's own soul, a word that is feminine (as in 42:6). The ancient Greek and other early translations read "I have said". Either way, the words are the psalmist's own confession.

decisions.choice: my Lord: my master
decisions.reason: The title ('Adonai) is used of God as master; the psalmist calls himself his servant.

decisions.choice: my good is not beyond you: I have no good apart from you
alternatives: my good does not rest on you
decisions.reason: The short phrase most likely means that every good the psalmist has is in God alone.

decisions.choice: My soul
decisions.reason: The feminine "you" is addressed to the soul (m1); Literal brackets the words, and Balanced and Readable say them so that the reader knows who is spoken to.

decisions.choice: "mình" for "you" when the psalmist speaks to his own soul
decisions.reason: The psalmist talks to himself (see the meaning decision). "mình" is the word Vietnamese uses when one speaks to oneself; "ngươi", the older form in such verses, is archaic. "thưa" is the respectful verb for speaking to God.

decisions.choice: The psalmist speaks to his own soul in 해라체 ("너는"), and the words he has said to the LORD are quoted in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The verse is the psalmist speaking to himself (meaning decision m1). Verses 3-4 and 7-9 then speak about God and others in the plain style with "나"; verses 1, 5-6 and 10-11 speak to God in 합쇼체 with "저", as the Hebrew turns to "you".

decisions.choice: você (to the psalmist's own soul)
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to his own soul (m1). The book keeps "tu" for God and "você" between people, so the soul is "você"; "tu" here would blur who is God in the verse.

decisions.choice: "तुमने" to the soul; "तू" to God
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to his own soul (m1) and, inside the quotation, to God. Hindi keeps "तू" for God and addresses the soul with "तुम", as Judges 5:21 does, so that the two are not confused.

decisions.choice: "मेरा प्रभु" (Adonai), with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: Here YHWH and Adonai stand side by side. YHWH has the divine_name span; "my Lord" is Adonai, a title, so it stays "प्रभु" whichever form of the name the reader chooses.

decisions.choice: "ты сказала", feminine
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you have said" is feminine and is spoken to the psalmist's own soul (m1); Russian "душа" is feminine too, so the verb can keep the Hebrew's gender.

decisions.choice: Adonai "主" (no span) inside the quotation, beside DN for YHWH
decisions.reason: "My Lord" is a title of a master (m2); 主 without the setting keeps it apart from the divine name.

records.literal_gloss: As for [the] holy ones who [are] in the land, they and [the] majestic ones, all my delight [is] in them.

en.L: As for the holy ones who [are] in the land, they [are] the majestic ones; all my delight [is] in them.
en.B: The holy people who live in the land are the truly great; they are my whole delight.
en.R: God's people who live in this land are the ones I admire. They make me very happy.

fr.L: Quant aux saints qui [sont] dans le pays, ils [sont] les nobles ; tout mon plaisir [est] en eux.
fr.B: Les fidèles qui vivent dans le pays sont les vrais grands ; ils font toute ma joie.
fr.R: Le peuple de Dieu qui vit dans ce pays, voilà les gens que j’admire. Ils me rendent très heureux.

sw.L: Kwa habari ya watakatifu walio katika nchi, \q wao [ndio] watukufu; \q furaha yangu yote [iko] kwao.
sw.B: Watu watakatifu wanaoishi katika nchi ndio wakuu kweli; \q wao ndio furaha yangu yote.
sw.R: Watu wa Mungu wanaoishi katika nchi hii ndio ninaowaheshimu. \q Wananifurahisha sana.

es.L: En cuanto a los santos que [están] en la tierra, ellos [son] los nobles; todo mi deleite [está] en ellos.
es.B: Los santos que viven en la tierra son los verdaderamente grandes; ellos son todo mi deleite.
es.R: El pueblo de Dios que vive en esta tierra es la gente que admiro. Me hacen muy feliz.

vi.L: Còn những người thánh [ở] trong xứ, \q họ [là] những người cao quý; \q mọi niềm vui thích của tôi [ở] nơi họ.
vi.B: Những người thánh sống trong xứ là những người thật sự cao quý; \q họ là cả niềm vui thích của tôi.
vi.R: Dân của Đức Chúa Trời sống trong xứ này là những người tôi ngưỡng mộ. \q Họ làm cho tôi rất vui.

ko.L: 땅에 있는 거룩한 이들로 말하면, \q 그들은 존귀한 이들이니, \q 나의 모든 기쁨이 그들에게 있다.
ko.B: 이 땅에 사는 거룩한 사람들은 참으로 존귀한 사람들이다. \q 그들은 나의 온전한 기쁨이다.
ko.R: 이 땅에 사는 하나님의 백성은 내가 우러러보는 사람들이다. \q 그들은 나를 무척 기쁘게 한다.

pt.L: Quanto aos santos que [estão] na terra, eles [são] os nobres; todo o meu prazer [está] neles.
pt.B: O povo santo que vive na terra — esses são os verdadeiramente grandes; neles está toda a minha alegria.
pt.R: O povo de Deus que vive nesta terra é o povo que eu admiro. Eles me deixam muito feliz.

am.L: በምድሪቱ ያሉ ቅዱሳንስ እነርሱ \q ክቡራን ናቸው፤ \q ደስታዬ ሁሉ በእነርሱ [ነው]።
am.B: በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ቅዱሳን በእውነት ታላላቆች ናቸው፤ \q እነርሱ ደስታዬ ሁሉ ናቸው።
am.R: በዚህች ምድር የሚኖሩ የእግዚአብሔር ሰዎች የማደንቃቸው ናቸው። \q እጅግ ደስ ያሰኙኛል።

hi.L: देश में जो पवित्र जन [हैं], वे ही महान [हैं]; मेरा सारा आनंद उन्हीं में [है]।
hi.B: देश में रहनेवाले पवित्र लोग ही सच्चे महान हैं; वे ही मेरा पूरा आनंद हैं।
hi.R: इस देश में रहनेवाले परमेश्वर के लोग ही वे हैं जिनका मैं आदर करता हूँ। वे मुझे बहुत ख़ुशी देते हैं।

ru.L: Что до святых, которые на земле, — они [и есть] величественные; вся моя радость — в них.
ru.B: Святые люди, живущие в этой земле, — вот кто по-настоящему велик; в них вся моя радость.
ru.R: Божьим народом, который живёт в этой земле, я восхищаюсь. Эти люди очень радуют меня.

ja.L: 地にいる聖なる者たち、彼らこそ尊い者たちであり、わたしの喜びはすべて彼らにある。
ja.B: この地に住む聖なる人々こそ、真に尊い人々。わたしの喜びはすべて、彼らにある。
ja.R: この地に住む神の民こそ、わたしが尊敬する人たちだ。その人たちは、わたしをとても幸せにしてくれる。

uk.L: Що ж до святих, які [є] на землі, — вони величні; уся моя втіха — в них.
uk.B: Святі люди, що живуть у цьому краї, — справді великі; вони — уся моя втіха.
uk.R: Божі люди, що живуть у цьому краї, — ті, ким я захоплююся. Вони дуже мене тішать.

decisions.choice: the holy ones: God's faithful people
alternatives: the holy ones of the land: other gods, whom the psalmist once delighted in or now renounces
decisions.reason: The verse is very hard to construe; the words do not fit together smoothly. Read with verse 2, it says that God's faithful people are the ones the psalmist delights in. Read with verse 4, "the holy ones in the land" and "the mighty ones" may be the gods of the land, which the psalmist turns away from. The first reading is followed.

decisions.choice: the majestic ones: the noble, the truly great
decisions.reason: The word ('addir) is used of nobles and leaders (Judges 5:13), and of the LORD's own majesty (8:2).

decisions.choice: God's people
decisions.reason: Readable says who the holy ones are on the reading followed (m1).

decisions.choice: "पवित्र जन" (L), "पवित्र लोग" (B)
decisions.reason: God's faithful people (m1), in the words Acts uses for the holy ones in this translation.

source.text: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־שְׂפָתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [are] their sorrows, another they have acquired; not I will pour out their drink offerings of blood, and not I will take their names on my lips.

en.L: Their sorrows will multiply [who] have acquired another [god]; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, and I will not take their names on my lips.
en.B: Those who court another god will have sorrow upon sorrow. I will not pour out their offerings of blood, or even speak the names of their gods.
en.R: People who chase after other gods will have more and more trouble. I will not join in their offerings of blood. I will not even say the names of their gods.

fr.L: Leurs douleurs se multiplieront, [à ceux qui] ont acquis un autre [dieu] ; je ne verserai pas leurs libations de sang, et je ne prendrai pas leurs noms sur mes lèvres.
fr.B: Ceux qui courtisent un autre dieu auront douleur sur douleur. Je ne verserai pas leurs offrandes de sang, et je ne prononcerai même pas le nom de leurs dieux.
fr.R: Les gens qui courent après d’autres dieux auront de plus en plus de malheurs. Je ne participerai pas à leurs offrandes de sang. Je ne dirai même pas le nom de leurs dieux.

sw.L: Huzuni zao zitaongezeka [wale] waliojipatia [mungu] mwingine; \q sitamimina sadaka zao za kinywaji za damu, \q wala sitayataja majina yao midomoni mwangu.
sw.B: Wale wanaomfuata mungu mwingine watapata huzuni juu ya huzuni. \q Sitamimina sadaka zao za damu, \q wala sitataja hata majina ya miungu yao.
sw.R: Watu wanaofuata miungu mingine watapata taabu zaidi na zaidi. \q Sitashiriki katika sadaka zao za damu. \q Sitataja hata majina ya miungu yao.

es.L: Se multiplicarán los dolores [de los que] han adquirido otro [dios]; no derramaré sus libaciones de sangre, ni tomaré sus nombres en mis labios.
es.B: Los que cortejan a otro dios tendrán dolor sobre dolor. No derramaré sus ofrendas de sangre, ni siquiera pronunciaré los nombres de sus dioses.
es.R: La gente que corre detrás de otros dioses tendrá cada vez más problemas. No participaré en sus ofrendas de sangre. Ni siquiera diré los nombres de sus dioses.

vi.L: Những kẻ đã lấy [thần] khác, nỗi sầu khổ của chúng sẽ gia tăng; \q tôi sẽ không dâng những lễ quán bằng máu của chúng, \q và tôi sẽ không nhắc tên chúng trên môi tôi.
vi.B: Những kẻ chạy theo thần khác sẽ chịu sầu khổ chồng chất. \q Tôi sẽ không dâng của lễ bằng máu như chúng, \q cũng chẳng nhắc đến tên các thần của chúng.
vi.R: Những người chạy theo các thần khác sẽ gặp càng ngày càng nhiều rắc rối. \q Tôi sẽ không tham gia vào những của lễ bằng máu của họ. \q Tôi sẽ không nhắc đến cả tên các thần của họ.

ko.L: 다른 [신을] 얻은 자들은 그들의 슬픔이 많아질 것이다. \q 나는 그들이 바치는 피의 전제를 붓지 않고, \q 그들의 이름을 내 입술에 올리지 않겠다.
ko.B: 다른 신을 좇는 자들은 슬픔에 슬픔이 더할 것이다. \q 나는 그들이 바치는 피의 제물을 붓지 않고, \q 그들이 섬기는 신들의 이름조차 입에 올리지 않겠다.
ko.R: 다른 신들을 따라가는 사람들은 점점 더 많은 괴로움을 겪을 것이다. \q 나는 그들이 바치는 피의 제물에 함께하지 않겠다. \q 그들이 섬기는 신들의 이름도 말하지 않겠다.

pt.L: Multiplicarão as suas dores [os que] adquiriram outro [deus]; não derramarei as suas libações de sangue, e não tomarei os nomes deles nos meus lábios.
pt.B: Os que cortejam outro deus terão dor sobre dor. Não derramarei as suas ofertas de sangue, nem sequer pronunciarei os nomes dos seus deuses.
pt.R: As pessoas que correm atrás de outros deuses vão ter cada vez mais problemas. Não vou participar das ofertas de sangue delas. Não vou nem dizer os nomes dos deuses delas.

am.L: ሌላን [አምላክ] ለራሳቸው የወሰዱ ኀዘናቸው ይበዛል፤ \q የደም የመጠጥ ቁርባናቸውን አላፈስም፤ \q ስሞቻቸውንም በከንፈሮቼ አላነሣም።
am.B: ሌላ አምላክን የሚከተሉ በኀዘን ላይ ኀዘን ይደርስባቸዋል። \q የደም መባቸውን አላፈስም፤ \q የአማልክቶቻቸውንም ስም እንኳ አልጠራም።
am.R: ሌሎች አማልክትን የሚከተሉ ሰዎች ችግራቸው እየበዛ ይሄዳል። \q በደም መባቸው አልተባበርም። \q የአማልክቶቻቸውን ስም እንኳ አልጠራም።

hi.L: जिन्होंने दूसरे [देवता] को अपना लिया है, उनके दुख बढ़ते जाएँगे; मैं उनके लहू के अर्घ नहीं उंडेलूँगा, और न उनके नाम अपने होंठों पर लाऊँगा।
hi.B: जो दूसरे देवता के पीछे जाते हैं, उन पर दुख पर दुख आएँगे। मैं उनके लहू के अर्घ नहीं उंडेलूँगा, और उनके देवताओं के नाम तक अपने होंठों पर नहीं लाऊँगा।
hi.R: जो लोग दूसरे देवताओं के पीछे भागते हैं, उनकी परेशानियाँ बढ़ती ही जाएँगी। मैं उनके लहू के चढ़ावों में भाग नहीं लूँगा। मैं उनके देवताओं के नाम तक नहीं लूँगा।

ru.L: Умножатся скорби [тех, кто] приобрёл другого [бога]; не буду возливать их возлияний из крови и не возьму их имён на мои уста.
ru.B: У тех, кто добивается другого бога, будет скорбь за скорбью. Я не стану возливать их кровавых возлияний и даже не произнесу имён их богов.
ru.R: У людей, которые гонятся за другими богами, будет всё больше бед. Я не стану участвовать в их кровавых жертвоприношениях. Я даже не буду называть имён их богов.

ja.L: ほかの[神]を手に入れた者たちの悲しみは増し加わる。わたしは、彼らの血の注ぎの供え物を注がず、彼らの名をわたしの唇にのせない。
ja.B: ほかの神を追い求める者たちには、悲しみに悲しみが重なる。わたしは、彼らの血の供え物を注がず、彼らの神々の名を口にすることもしない。
ja.R: ほかの神々を追いかける人たちには、困ったことがどんどん増える。わたしは、彼らの血のささげ物に加わらない。彼らの神々の名前を言うことさえしない。

uk.L: Помножаться печалі тих, [хто] здобув собі іншого [бога]; я не виливатиму їхніх жертовних виливань із крові і не візьму їхніх імен на свої губи.
uk.B: Ті, хто запобігає перед іншим богом, матимуть горе за горем. Я не виливатиму їхніх кривавих жертв і навіть не вимовлятиму імен їхніх богів.
uk.R: Люди, які женуться за іншими богами, матимуть дедалі більше біди. Я не братиму участі в їхніх кривавих жертвах. Я навіть не вимовлятиму імен їхніх богів.

decisions.choice: acquired another god: taken another god as their own
decisions.reason: The verb (mahar) is used of paying a bride-price to win a wife (Exodus 22); here it pictures people wooing another god. Others read a related verb meaning to hurry after. "God" is not in the Hebrew but is implied by the drink offerings and names that follow.

decisions.choice: drink offerings of blood: offerings to other gods
decisions.reason: Drink offerings were poured out in worship (Numbers 15:5). Offerings of blood may be a pagan rite, or offerings brought by violent people; either way, the psalmist will have no part in them.

decisions.choice: take their names on my lips: speak their names in worship
decisions.reason: Israel was told not even to mention the names of other gods (Exodus 23:13).

decisions.choice: the names of their gods
decisions.reason: "Their names" are the names of the other gods (m1), as Exodus 23:13 shows; Balanced and Readable say so.
"अर्घ" is the drink offering of Numbers 28-29 in this translation; Readable uses the everyday word for an offering.

decisions.choice: nesekh "注ぎの供え物" (L), "供え物" (B), as the Pentateuch's drink offering
decisions.reason: The offering is poured out to other gods (m2); Balanced keeps the verb 注ぐ and drops the doubled "pour".

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is the] portion of my share and my cup; you [are] holding my lot.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] the portion of my share and my cup; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] holding my lot.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the share I have been given and the cup I drink; it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who hold my lot secure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is all I have and all I need, like a share of land or a cup to drink from. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep safe everything that is mine.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] la portion de ma part et ma coupe ; {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiens mon lot.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est la part qui m’est donnée et la coupe que je bois ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui gardes mon lot en sûreté.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est tout ce que j’ai et tout ce dont j’ai besoin, comme une part de terre ou une coupe où boire. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gardes en sécurité tout ce qui est à moi.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] fungu la sehemu yangu na kikombe changu; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] unayeshika kura yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye sehemu niliyopewa na kikombe ninachokinywea; \q ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayeilinda kura yangu iwe salama.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye kila kitu nilicho nacho na kila ninachohitaji, kama shamba la urithi au kikombe cha kunywea. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unalinda salama kila kilicho changu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] la parte de mi lote y mi copa; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [estás] sosteniendo mi suerte.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es la parte que me ha tocado y la copa que bebo; eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quien mantiene segura mi suerte.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es todo lo que tengo y todo lo que necesito, como una parcela de tierra o una copa para beber. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} guardas a salvo todo lo que es mío.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] phần sản nghiệp và chén của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đang] nắm giữ phần số của tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là phần tôi được chia và là chén tôi uống; \q chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ vững phần số của tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là tất cả những gì tôi có và tôi cần, như một phần đất được chia hay một chén nước để uống. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ an toàn mọi điều thuộc về tôi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 저의 분깃의 몫이시며 저의 잔이십니다. \q 주님께서 저의 제비를 붙들고 계십니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 제가 받은 몫이시며 제가 마실 잔이십니다. \q 제 몫을 든든히 지켜 주시는 분은 바로 주님이십니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 제가 가진 전부이시며 제게 필요한 전부이십니다. 그분은 제게 주어진 땅이나 마실 잔과 같으십니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 제 것을 모두 안전하게 지켜 주십니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] a porção da minha parte e o meu cálice; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sustentas a minha sorte.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é a parte que me coube e o cálice que eu bebo; és {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} quem mantém segura a minha sorte.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é tudo o que eu tenho e tudo de que preciso, como um pedaço de terra ou um copo para beber. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guardas em segurança tudo o que é meu.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የድርሻዬ ዕድል ፈንታና ጽዋዬ [ነው]፤ \q ዕጣዬን የምትይዝ አንተ [ነህ]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተሰጠኝ ድርሻና የምጠጣው ጽዋ ነው፤ \q ዕጣዬን አጽንተህ የምትጠብቅ አንተ ነህ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ርስት መሬት ወይም እንደሚጠጣ ጽዋ ያለኝ ሁሉና የሚያስፈልገኝ ሁሉ ነው። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የእኔ የሆነውን ሁሉ ትጠብቃለህ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे भाग का अंश और मेरा कटोरा [हैं]; तू मेरी चिट्ठी को थामे [हुए है]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही वह भाग हैं जो मुझे मिला है, और वह कटोरा जिससे मैं पीता हूँ; तू ही मेरे भाग को सुरक्षित रखता है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही मेरा सब कुछ हैं, और मुझे जो चाहिए, वह सब वही हैं, जैसे ज़मीन का एक हिस्सा या पीने का कटोरा। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो कुछ मेरा है, उसे तू सुरक्षित रखता है।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — доля моего удела и моя чаша; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} держишь мой жребий.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — доля, данная мне, и чаша, которую я пью; это {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} надёжно хранишь мой жребий.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — всё, что у меня есть, и всё, что мне нужно, как надел земли или чаша, из которой пьют. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} бережёшь всё, что принадлежит мне.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの割り当ての分け前、またわたしの杯。あなたは、わたしのくじを保っておられる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ、わたしに与えられた分け前、わたしの飲む杯。わたしの受ける分を確かに守っておられるのは、あなただ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの持っているすべて、わたしに必要なすべてだ。分けてもらった土地や、飲み物の入った杯のように。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしのものをすべて、あなたは守ってくださる。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — частка мого наділу і моя чаша; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} тримаєш мій жереб.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — моя частка, яку мені дано, і чаша, з якої я пʼю; це {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} надійно тримаєш мій жереб.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — усе, що я маю, і все, що мені потрібно, як наділ землі чи чаша, з якої пʼють. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} бережеш усе, що належить мені.

decisions.choice: the portion of my share: like the Levites, whose share was the LORD
decisions.reason: When Israel received the land, the Levites were given no land, for "I am your portion and your share", the LORD said (Numbers 18:20; Deuteronomy 10:9). The psalmist says the LORD himself is his share.

decisions.choice: my cup: what I am given
decisions.reason: A person's cup is the lot God gives, of blessing (23:5) or of judgment (11:6).

decisions.choice: you hold my lot: my future is safe with you
decisions.reason: Land was shared out by lot (Joshua 18:6-10); the psalmist's lot, what life has given him, is held firm by God.

decisions.choice: all I have and all I need, like a share of land or a cup to drink from
alternatives: the portion of my share and my cup
decisions.reason: Readable explains the pictures of the share of land and the cup (m1, m2).
The lot is the one cast to share out the land, "चिट्ठी" as in Joshua (m3); Balanced says what it decided, the psalmist's share.

decisions.choice: cheleq "分け前" (every level, as Lamentations); goral "くじ" (L), "受ける分" (B)
decisions.reason: The share of land given by lot, like the Levites' share that was the LORD himself (m1, m3).

source.text: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] lines have fallen for me in pleasant [places]; indeed, [the] inheritance is beautiful to me.

en.L: [The] lines have fallen for me in pleasant [places]; indeed, the inheritance is beautiful to me.
en.B: The measuring lines have marked out a lovely place for me; truly, the land I inherit delights me.
en.R: What God has given me is wonderful, like a beautiful piece of land. I love what I have received.

fr.L: [Les] cordeaux sont tombés pour moi en [des lieux] agréables ; oui, l’héritage est beau pour moi.
fr.B: Les cordeaux d’arpenteur m’ont tracé un lieu charmant ; vraiment, la terre dont j’hérite me ravit.
fr.R: Ce que Dieu m’a donné est merveilleux, comme un beau terrain. J’aime ce que j’ai reçu.

sw.L: Kamba za kupimia zimeniangukia mahali pazuri; \q naam, urithi huo ni mzuri kwangu.
sw.B: Kamba za kupimia zimenipimia mahali pa kupendeza; \q kweli, nchi ninayoirithi inanifurahisha.
sw.R: Kile ambacho Mungu amenipa ni kizuri ajabu, kama kipande cha ardhi kilicho kizuri. \q Ninapenda kile nilichopokea.

es.L: [Las] cuerdas de medir han caído para mí en [lugares] agradables; sí, la herencia es hermosa para mí.
es.B: Los cordeles de medir me han señalado un lugar precioso; de verdad, la tierra que heredo me llena de alegría.
es.R: Lo que Dios me ha dado es maravilloso, como un hermoso terreno. Me encanta lo que he recibido.

vi.L: Những dây đo đã rơi cho tôi vào [những nơi] tươi đẹp; \q thật vậy, sản nghiệp tôi thật đẹp đối với tôi.
vi.B: Dây đo đã chia cho tôi một chỗ thật tươi đẹp; thật vậy, \q phần đất tôi thừa hưởng làm tôi vui thích.
vi.R: Những gì Đức Chúa Trời ban cho tôi thật tuyệt vời, như một mảnh đất xinh đẹp. \q Tôi yêu thích những gì tôi đã nhận.

ko.L: 줄들이 저를 위해 아름다운 [곳에] 떨어졌으니, \q 참으로 그 유산이 제게 아름답습니다.
ko.B: 측량하는 줄이 제게 아름다운 곳을 정해 주었으니, \q 참으로 제가 물려받은 땅이 저를 기쁘게 합니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 제게 주신 것은 아름다운 땅처럼 참으로 좋습니다. \q 저는 제가 받은 것을 사랑합니다.

pt.L: [As] cordas caíram para mim em [lugares] agradáveis; sim, a herança é bela para mim.
pt.B: As cordas de medir marcaram para mim um lugar encantador; de fato, a terra que herdo me alegra.
pt.R: O que Deus me deu é maravilhoso, como um belo pedaço de terra. Eu amo o que recebi.

am.L: ገመዶቹ ባማሩ [ስፍራዎች] ወደቁልኝ፤ \q በእርግጥም ርስቱ ለእኔ ያማረ ነው።
am.B: የመለኪያ ገመዶች ያማረ ስፍራ ለክተውልኛል፤ \q በእውነት የምወርሰው ምድር ደስ ያሰኘኛል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ እንደ ውብ መሬት ድንቅ ነው። \q የተቀበልኩትን እወደዋለሁ።

hi.L: मेरे लिए [नापने की] डोरियाँ मनभावने [स्थानों] में पड़ी हैं; हाँ, निज भाग मुझे सुंदर लगता है।
hi.B: नापने की डोरियों ने मेरे लिए एक सुहावनी जगह ठहराई है; सचमुच, जो भूमि मुझे निज भाग में मिली है, वह मुझे बहुत भाती है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने मुझे जो दिया है, वह अद्भुत है, ज़मीन के एक सुंदर टुकड़े के समान। जो कुछ मुझे मिला है, वह मुझे बहुत प्यारा है।

ru.L: Верёвки упали мне на приятных [местах]; поистине, наследие прекрасно для меня.
ru.B: Мерные верёвки отмерили мне прекрасное место; поистине, земля, которую я наследую, радует меня.
ru.R: То, что Бог дал мне, чудесно, как прекрасный участок земли. Я рад тому, что получил.

ja.L: 測り綱は、わたしのために麗しい所に落ちた。まことに、[その]嗣業はわたしにとって美しい。
ja.B: 測り綱は、わたしのために麗しい地を割り当てた。まことに、わたしの受け継ぐ地は、わたしを喜ばせる。
ja.R: 神がわたしにくださったものは、美しい土地のようにすばらしい。わたしは、受け取ったものが大好きだ。

uk.L: Мірильні шнури впали мені в приємних [місцях]; так, спадщина гарна для мене.
uk.B: Мірильні шнури відміряли мені чудове місце; справді, земля, яку я успадкував, тішить мене.
uk.R: Те, що дав мені Бог, чудове, як гарна ділянка землі. Я люблю те, що отримав.

decisions.choice: the lines have fallen: the measuring lines that mark out land
decisions.reason: Measuring lines marked out each family's land (Joshua 17:5; Micah 2:5). The psalmist's share, the LORD himself (verse 5), is a lovely place.

decisions.choice: inheritance: the share passed on in a family
decisions.reason: The word (nachalah) is a family's land handed down; here it is a picture of what God has given the psalmist.

decisions.choice: What God has given me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture and names the giver (m1).

decisions.choice: "निज भाग"
decisions.reason: The word for a family's share of the land, as Joshua has it in this translation (m2).

source.text: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will bless YHWH who has counseled me; also [in the] nights my kidneys have instructed me.

en.L: I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has counseled me; also [in the] nights my kidneys instruct me.
en.B: I bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my adviser; even at night my deepest self keeps teaching me.
en.R: I praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows me what to do. Even at night, deep inside, I learn what is right.

fr.L: Je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui m’a conseillé ; même [les] nuits mes reins m’instruisent.
fr.B: Je bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon conseiller ; même la nuit, le fond de mon être continue de m’enseigner.
fr.R: Je loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me montre ce que je dois faire. Même la nuit, au fond de moi, j’apprends ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye amenishauri; \q hata usiku figo zangu zinanifundisha.
sw.B: Ninambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mshauri wangu; \q hata usiku ndani kabisa ya nafsi yangu ninaendelea kufundishwa.
sw.R: Ninamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ananionyesha la kufanya. \q Hata usiku, ndani ya moyo wangu, ninajifunza yaliyo sahihi.

es.L: Bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que me ha aconsejado; aun [en las] noches mis riñones me instruyen.
es.B: Bendigo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, mi consejero; aun de noche lo más profundo de mi ser me sigue enseñando.
es.R: Alabo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me muestra qué hacer. Aun de noche, en lo más profundo de mi ser, aprendo lo que es correcto.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã khuyên bảo tôi; \q cả trong những đêm, thận tôi cũng dạy dỗ tôi.
vi.B: Tôi chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng khuyên bảo tôi; \q ngay cả ban đêm, tận đáy lòng tôi vẫn dạy dỗ tôi.
vi.R: Tôi ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ cho tôi điều phải làm. \q Ngay cả ban đêm, sâu thẳm trong lòng, tôi học biết điều đúng.

ko.L: 나를 조언하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 내가 송축하겠다. \q 밤마다 내 콩팥이 나를 가르친다.
ko.B: 나에게 조언해 주시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 내가 송축한다. \q 밤에도 내 깊은 속마음이 나를 일깨운다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양한다. 그분께서 내가 할 일을 보여 주시기 때문이다. \q 밤에도 나는 마음 깊은 곳에서 무엇이 옳은지 배운다.

pt.L: Bendirei {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que me aconselhou; também [nas] noites os meus rins me instruem.
pt.B: Eu bendigo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o meu conselheiro; até de noite o meu íntimo continua me ensinando.
pt.R: Eu louvo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me mostra o que fazer. Até de noite, bem lá dentro, aprendo o que é certo.

am.L: የመከረኝን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እባርካለሁ፤ \q በሌሊትም ደግሞ ኩላሊቶቼ ያስተምሩኛል።
am.B: መካሪዬ የሆነውን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እባርካለሁ፤ \q በሌሊትም እንኳ ውስጣዊ ማንነቴ ያስተምረኛል።
am.R: ምን ማድረግ እንዳለብኝ ስለሚያሳየኝ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመሰግናለሁ። \q በሌሊትም እንኳ በውስጤ ትክክል የሆነውን እማራለሁ።

hi.L: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहूँगा, जिन्होंने मुझे सम्मति दी है; रातों को भी मेरे गुर्दे मुझे सिखाते हैं।
hi.B: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहता हूँ, जो मेरे सलाहकार हैं; रात को भी मेरा अंतर्मन मुझे सिखाता रहता है।
hi.R: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करता हूँ, क्योंकि वे मुझे दिखाते हैं कि मुझे क्या करना है। रात को भी, अपने भीतर गहराई में, मैं सीखता हूँ कि क्या सही है।

ru.L: Благословлю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, который дал мне совет; и [по] ночам наставляют меня мои почки.
ru.B: Благословляю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, моего советчика; даже ночью глубина моей души продолжает наставлять меня.
ru.R: Я хвалю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} показывает мне, что делать. Даже ночью в глубине души я узнаю, что правильно.

ja.L: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる、わたしに助言を与えられた方を。夜ごとにも、わたしの腎臓がわたしを諭す。
ja.B: わたしは、わたしに助言をくださる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる。夜になっても、わたしの心の奥底が、わたしを教え続ける。
ja.R: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる。その方は、わたしがどうすればよいかを教えてくださる。夜でも、心の奥深くで、わたしは正しいことを学ぶ。

uk.L: Я благословлятиму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що дав мені пораду; навіть [уночі] мої нирки повчають мене.
uk.B: Я благословляю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, мого порадника; навіть уночі моє найглибше єство навчає мене.
uk.R: Я хвалю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} показує мені, що робити. Навіть уночі, глибоко всередині, я пізнаю, що правильно.

decisions.choice: my kidneys: my inmost self
decisions.reason: The kidneys stand for the hidden depths of a person, the feelings and conscience (7:10; Jeremiah 17:10). The LORD's counsel works there, even in the night.

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him
decisions.reason: When people bless God they praise him and give him thanks.

decisions.choice: nights: night after night
decisions.reason: The plural means that it happens night after night.

decisions.choice: "kumbariki BWANA" for blessing God (L, B); "kumsifu" (praise) at Readable, as the English Readable
decisions.reason: When people bless God they praise and thank him (m2). Swahili can use the same verb, "kubariki", for God blessing people and people blessing God, which keeps the link the Hebrew makes; Readable uses the plainer "kumsifu".

decisions.choice: "chúc tụng" for blessing God (L, B); "ca ngợi" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "chúc tụng" for bless, "ca ngợi" for praise and "cảm tạ" for give thanks; Readable uses "ca ngợi" here as the English Readable says "praise".

decisions.choice: "송축하다" (L, B) for blessing God; "찬양하다" at Readable, as the English says "praise"
decisions.reason: Terms note: bless (God) is 송축하다, kept apart from praise (찬양하다) and thanks (감사하다) so the three Hebrew verbs stay distinct. A person cannot give God a blessing, so "복을 빌다" would be wrong. This holds through Psalms 16-25.

decisions.choice: "मेरे गुर्दे" (L); "मेरा अंतर्मन" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the kidneys as the seat of the inmost self (m1). Literal keeps the word, as the English Literal does; Balanced says what it means.

decisions.choice: "धन्य कहूँगा" (L), "धन्य कहता हूँ" (B); "स्तुति करता हूँ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the poetry terms note settles, blessing God is "धन्य कहना"; Readable says "praise", as the English Readable does (m2).

decisions.choice: "мои почки" (L); "глубина моей души" (B)
decisions.reason: The kidneys stand for a person's inmost self (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew body word, as the English Literal does; Balanced says what it means.

decisions.choice: barekh with God as object "ほめたたえる" at every level (the English Readable has "praise"); kilyot "腎臓" (L, as Psalm 7:10), "心の奥底" (B), "心の奥深く" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter keeps barekh apart from hallel (賛美する); the kidneys stand for the inmost self (m1).

decisions.choice: "благословляти" (L, B) for blessing God, through the book; Readable "хвалити" where the English Readable says praise
decisions.reason: To bless God is to speak well of him with thanks; the shared terms note keeps "благословляти".

source.text: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: I have set YHWH before me continually; for [he is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

en.L: I have set {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before me continually; for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
en.B: I have placed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of me at all times; since {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is there at my right hand, I will never stumble.
en.R: I always keep {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in mind. He is right beside me to help me, so nothing can shake me.

fr.L: J’ai placé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant moi continuellement ; car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] à ma droite, je ne serai pas ébranlé.
fr.B: J’ai mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant moi en tout temps ; puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est là, à ma droite, je ne tomberai jamais.
fr.R: Je pense toujours {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il est juste à côté de moi pour m’aider, alors rien ne peut m’ébranler.

sw.L: Nimemweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yangu siku zote; \q kwa kuwa [yu] upande wangu wa kuume, sitatikiswa.
sw.B: Nimemweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yangu wakati wote; \q kwa kuwa yupo pale mkono wangu wa kuume, \q sitajikwaa kamwe.
sw.R: Daima ninamweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akilini mwangu. \q Yuko karibu nami kunisaidia, kwa hiyo hakuna kitu kitakachonitikisa.

es.L: He puesto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} delante de mí sin cesar; porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está] a mi mano derecha, no vacilaré.
es.B: He colocado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} frente a mí en todo momento; como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está allí, a mi derecha, nunca tropezaré.
es.R: Siempre tengo presente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Él está a mi lado para ayudarme, así que nada puede hacerme caer.

vi.L: Tôi đã đặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trước mặt tôi luôn luôn; \q vì [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở] bên tay phải tôi, tôi sẽ không bị lay chuyển.
vi.B: Tôi luôn đặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trước mặt mình; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở ngay bên phải tôi, \q tôi sẽ không bao giờ vấp ngã.
vi.R: Tôi luôn nhớ đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ngài ở ngay bên cạnh \q để giúp tôi, nên không gì có thể làm tôi lung lay.

ko.L: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 항상 내 앞에 모셨으니, \q [그분께서] 내 오른편에 [계시므로] 나는 흔들리지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 언제나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 내 앞에 모신다. \q 그분께서 내 오른편에 계시니 \q 나는 결코 흔들리지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 생각한다. \q 그분께서 바로 내 곁에서 나를 도우시니, 아무것도 나를 흔들 수 없다.

pt.L: Pus {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diante de mim continuamente; porque [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está] à minha direita, não vacilarei.
pt.B: Eu pus {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sempre diante de mim; com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} à minha direita, não serei abalado.
pt.R: Eu sempre mantenho {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} no pensamento. Ele está bem ao meu lado para me ajudar, e por isso nada vai me abalar.

am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አድርጌዋለሁ፤ \q እርሱ በቀኜ \q ስላለ አልናወጥም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሁልጊዜ አስባለሁ። \q ሊረዳኝ እርሱ አጠገቤ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ምንም አያናውጠኝም።

hi.L: मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को सदा अपने सामने रखा है; क्योंकि [वे] मेरे दाहिने [हाथ] [हैं], मैं डिग न जाऊँगा।
hi.B: मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को सदा अपनी आँखों के सामने रखा है; वे मेरे दाहिने हाथ हैं, इसलिए मैं डिगूँगा नहीं।
hi.R: मैं हमेशा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को ध्यान में रखता हूँ। वे ठीक मेरे पास हैं और मेरी सहायता करते हैं, इसलिए कोई चीज़ मुझे हिला नहीं सकती।

ru.L: Я поставил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} перед собой всегда; потому что [{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}] по правую руку от меня, я не поколеблюсь.
ru.B: Я всегда держу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} перед собой: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} по правую руку от меня, и я не поколеблюсь.
ru.R: Я всегда помню о {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}. Он стоит возле меня, чтобы помочь мне, и ничто меня не поколеблет.

ja.L: わたしは、いつも{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をわたしの前に置いた。[その方が]わたしの右におられるので、わたしは揺るがない。
ja.B: わたしは、いつも{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を目の前に置いている。その方がわたしの右におられるので、わたしは決してよろめかない。
ja.R: わたしは、いつも{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のことを心にとめている。その方がすぐそばにいて助けてくださるので、何もわたしを揺るがすことはできない。

uk.L: Я поставив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} перед собою завжди; бо [{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] праворуч від мене, я не похитнуся.
uk.B: Я завжди ставлю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} перед собою; оскільки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} праворуч від мене, я ніколи не спіткнуся.
uk.R: Я завжди памʼятаю про {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Він поруч зі мною, щоб допомагати, тож ніщо не може мене похитнути.

decisions.choice: set the LORD before me: keep him always in view
decisions.reason: The psalmist lives with his attention fixed on the LORD.

decisions.choice: at my right hand: beside me as protector
decisions.reason: A defender stood at the right hand of the one he protected (109:31; 121:5).

decisions.choice: quoted by Peter in Acts 2
decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 8-11 in his sermon at Pentecost (Acts 2:25-28) and applies them to the resurrection of Jesus; Paul quotes verse 10 in Acts 13:35.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:25 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 8-11 in Acts 2:25-28 (m3). Each level keeps the Portuguese of Acts 2:25 at the same level where the Hebrew says the same: "continuamente", "à minha direita", "vacilar" (L); "com ele à minha direita, não serei abalado" (B); "Ele está bem ao meu lado, e por isso nada vai me abalar" (R). The opening follows the Hebrew "I have set", where Acts' Greek has "I saw".

decisions.choice: Psalm 16:8-11 keeps the Amharic of Acts 2:25-28 where the Hebrew and the Greek agree ("በቀኜ ስላለ አልናወጥም", "ስለዚህ ልቤ ... ተደሰተ", "ነፍሴን ወደ ሲኦል አሳልፈህ አትተዋትምና", "የሕይወትን መንገድ"), and follows the Hebrew where they differ: "I have set the LORD before me" (Acts "I saw"), with the divine name for "the Lord"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes the Greek translation. Where it reads the Hebrew differently, the psalm says what the Hebrew says, and each difference is noted on its verse (16:9, 10, 11).

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:25 at each level, with "रखा है" (L) for "I have set"
alternatives: "मैंने प्रभु को सदा अपने सामने देखा", as Acts 2:25 L
decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 8-11 in Acts 2:25-28 (m3), and this translation matches his wording where the Hebrew says the same. The Hebrew says "I have set" where the Greek says "I saw", so Literal says "रखा है"; Balanced already reads so in Acts.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:25 where the Hebrew says the same
decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 8-11 in Acts 2:25-28 (m3). The Psalm keeps the Russian of Acts at each level ("перед собой всегда", "по правую руку от меня", "не поколеблюсь", "ничто меня не поколеблет"); where Acts follows the Greek "I saw the Lord", the Psalm translates the Hebrew "I have set the LORD".

decisions.choice: 16:8-11 keep the Japanese of Acts 2:25-28 where the Hebrew reads as Peter's Greek ("わたしの右におられる", "揺るがない", "陰府に捨て置く", "命の道"), and translate the Hebrew where it differs: "わたしの栄光" (not "舌"), "安らかに住まう" (not "希望のうちに"), "あなたの誠実な者" (not "聖なる者"), "穴" (not "朽ち果てること")
decisions.reason: A reader comparing the psalm with Acts 2 should find the same words where the texts agree, and the Hebrew where the Greek translation differs (m3, m4).

source.text: לָכֵ֤ן׀שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore is glad my heart, and rejoices my glory; also my flesh will dwell in security.

en.L: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; also my flesh will dwell in security.
en.B: That is why my heart is glad and my spirit celebrates; my body too will live in safety.
en.R: So I am happy and full of joy. I know my body will be safe.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi mon cœur est dans la joie et ma gloire exulte ; même ma chair habitera en sécurité.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi mon cœur est dans la joie et mon esprit est en fête ; mon corps aussi vivra en sûreté.
fr.R: Alors je suis heureux et plein de joie. Je sais que mon corps sera en sécurité.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahi na utukufu wangu unashangilia; \q hata mwili wangu utakaa salama.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana moyo wangu unafurahi na roho yangu inashangilia; \q mwili wangu pia utaishi kwa usalama.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nina furaha na shangwe tele. \q Ninajua kwamba mwili wangu utakuwa salama.

es.L: Por tanto se alegra mi corazón y se goza mi gloria; también mi carne habitará segura.
es.B: Por eso mi corazón está alegre y mi espíritu hace fiesta; también mi cuerpo vivirá seguro.
es.R: Por eso estoy feliz y lleno de alegría. Sé que mi cuerpo estará a salvo.

vi.L: Vì vậy lòng tôi vui mừng và vinh quang tôi hớn hở; \q thân xác tôi cũng sẽ ở trong an ninh.
vi.B: Vì thế lòng tôi vui mừng và tâm linh tôi hân hoan; \q thân thể tôi cũng sẽ được sống an toàn.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi vui mừng và đầy hân hoan. \q Tôi biết thân thể tôi sẽ được an toàn.

ko.L: 그러므로 내 마음이 기쁘고 내 영광이 즐거워하며, \q 내 육체도 안전히 머물 것이다.
ko.B: 그래서 내 마음이 기쁘고 내 영도 즐거워한다. \q 내 몸도 안전하게 살 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 행복하고 기쁨이 넘친다. \q 내 몸도 안전할 것을 나는 안다.

pt.L: Por isso o meu coração se alegra, e a minha glória exulta; também a minha carne habitará em segurança.
pt.B: Por isso o meu coração está cheio de alegria, e o meu espírito canta de júbilo; até o meu corpo viverá em segurança.
pt.R: Por isso o meu coração está feliz, e eu estou cheio de alegria. Sei que o meu corpo vai estar seguro.

am.L: ስለዚህ ልቤ ተደሰተ፤ ክብሬም ሐሤት አደረገ፤ \q ደግሞም ሥጋዬ ተማምኖ ይኖራል።
am.B: ስለዚህ ልቤ በደስታ ተሞላ፤ መንፈሴም ሐሤት አደረገ፤ \q ሰውነቴም እንኳ በደኅንነት ያርፋል።
am.R: ስለዚህ ልቤ ደስተኛ ነው፤ በደስታም ተሞልቻለሁ። \q ሰውነቴም በደኅንነት እንደሚኖር አውቃለሁ።

hi.L: इस कारण मेरा मन आनंदित है, और मेरी महिमा मगन है; मेरा शरीर भी निश्चिंत बसा रहेगा।
hi.B: इसलिए मेरा मन आनंद से भर गया है, और मेरी आत्मा उत्सव मनाती है; मेरा शरीर भी सुरक्षित रहेगा।
hi.R: इसलिए मैं ख़ुश हूँ और आनंद से भरा हूँ। मैं जानता हूँ कि मेरा शरीर सुरक्षित रहेगा।

ru.L: Поэтому радуется моё сердце и ликует моя слава; и моя плоть будет обитать в безопасности.
ru.B: Поэтому моё сердце полно радости и мой дух ликует; и моё тело тоже будет жить в безопасности.
ru.R: Поэтому моё сердце радуется, и я полон радости. Я знаю, что даже моё тело будет в безопасности.

ja.L: それゆえ、わたしの心は喜び、わたしの栄光は喜び躍る。わたしの肉もまた、安らかに住まう。
ja.B: だから、わたしの心は喜び、わたしの魂は喜び躍る。わたしの体も、安らかに住む。
ja.R: だから、わたしはうれしくて、喜びでいっぱいだ。わたしの体も守られて安全だと、わたしは知っている。

uk.L: Тому радіє моє серце і веселиться моя слава; і моє тіло житиме в безпеці.
uk.B: Ось чому моє серце радіє, а мій дух святкує; і моє тіло житиме в безпеці.
uk.R: Тож я щасливий і сповнений радості. Я знаю, що моє тіло буде в безпеці.

decisions.choice: my glory: my inmost self
decisions.reason: "My glory" (kevodi) is a poetic word for a person's inner self, set beside "heart" (7:6; 30:13; Genesis 49:6). The ancient Greek translation has "my tongue", and Acts 2:26 quotes it so.

decisions.choice: my flesh will dwell in security: my body will be safe
decisions.reason: The body too will be safe in God's keeping. The ancient Greek translation reads "will rest in hope", the form quoted in Acts 2:26.

decisions.choice: my spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "my glory" means here (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:26, with the Hebrew "glória" and "em segurança"
decisions.reason: Acts 2:26 quotes the Greek translation, which reads "my tongue" and "rest in hope" (m1, m2). The psalm keeps the Portuguese of Acts 2:26 at each level ("Por isso o meu coração se alegra/está cheio de alegria ... até o meu corpo") but translates the Hebrew where it differs: "a minha glória" (L), "o meu espírito" (B), "em segurança".

decisions.choice: "ክብሬም ሐሤት አደረገ" (my glory rejoices, L; B "መንፈሴም") and "ተማምኖ ይኖራል" (will dwell in security), following the Hebrew
alternatives: "አንደበቴም ሐሤት አደረገ" and "በተስፋ ይኖራል", as Acts 2:26
decisions.reason: The Greek has "my tongue" and "in hope" where the Hebrew has "my glory" (the inmost self) and "in security" (meaning decisions m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "मेरी महिमा" (L), "मेरी आत्मा" (B); "निश्चिंत", "सुरक्षित"
decisions.reason: Acts 2:26 follows the Greek Old Testament, "my tongue rejoiced" and "my flesh will dwell in hope". The Hebrew has "my glory", the inmost self (m1), and "in security" (m2), so the psalm says those; the rest of the line keeps the shape of Acts 2:26.

decisions.choice: "моя слава" (L), "мой дух" (B); "в безопасности"
decisions.reason: The line keeps the words of Acts 2:26 in this translation where the Hebrew says the same ("моё сердце", "моя плоть будет обитать", "моё тело"). Acts follows the Greek, which reads "my tongue" and "in hope"; the Hebrew has "my glory", the inner self (m1), and "in security" (m2), and the Psalm translates the Hebrew.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: For not you will abandon my soul to Sheol; not you will let your faithful one see [the] pit.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not abandon my soul to Sheol; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful one see the pit.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not give me up to Sheol, nor allow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal one to see the pit.
en.R: You will not leave me in the place of the dead. You will not let the one who is faithful to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} go down to the grave.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’abandonneras pas mon âme au Shéol ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne laisseras pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} fidèle voir la fosse.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne me livreras pas au séjour des morts, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne permettras pas que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} fidèle voie la fosse.
fr.R: Tu ne me laisseras pas au séjour des morts. Tu ne laisseras pas celui qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}est fidèle descendre dans la tombe.

sw.L: Kwa maana hutaiacha nafsi yangu Kuzimu; \q hutamwacha mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} aone shimo.
sw.B: Kwa maana hutaniacha Kuzimu, \q wala hutamwacha mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} aone shimo.
sw.R: Hutaniacha Kuzimu. \q Hutamwacha yule aliye mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ashuke kaburini.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no abandonarás mi alma al Seol; no permitirás que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fiel vea la fosa.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no me entregarás al lugar de los muertos, ni dejarás que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fiel vea la fosa.
es.R: Tú no me dejarás en el lugar de los muertos. No dejarás que el que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} es fiel baje a la tumba.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bỏ linh hồn tôi nơi Âm Phủ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không để người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy huyệt mộ.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không phó tôi cho Âm Phủ, \q cũng không để người trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy huyệt mộ.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ không bỏ tôi ở nơi của người chết. \q Ngài sẽ không để người trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải xuống mồ.

ko.L: 참으로 주님께서 제 영혼을 스올에 버려두지 않으시고, \q 주님의 신실한 이가 구덩이를 보게 하지 않으실 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 저를 스올에 내주지 않으시고, \q 주님께 신실한 이가 구덩이를 보게 내버려 두지 않으실 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 저를 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에 버려두지 않으실 것입니다. \q 주님께 충성하는 사람이 무덤으로 내려가게 하지 않으실 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não abandonarás a minha alma no Sheol, nem deixarás que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo veja a cova.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não me abandonarás no mundo dos mortos, nem permitirás que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo veja a cova.
pt.R: Tu não vais me deixar no mundo dos mortos. Não vais deixar que quem é fiel a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} desça à sepultura.

am.L: ነፍሴን ወደ ሲኦል አሳልፈህ አትተዋትምና፤ \q ታማኝህንም ጉድጓዱን እንዲያይ አትፈቅድም።
am.B: እኔን በሙታን ዓለም አትተወኝምና፤ \q ታማኝህም ጉድጓዱን እንዲያይ አትፈቅድም።
am.R: በሙታን ዓለም አትተወኝም። \q ለአንተ ታማኝ የሆነውን ወደ መቃብር እንዲወርድ አትፈቅድም።

hi.L: क्योंकि तू मेरे प्राण को शिओल में नहीं छोड़ेगा, और न अपने भक्त को गड्ढा देखने देगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि तू मुझे अधोलोक में नहीं छोड़ेगा, और न अपने विश्वासयोग्य जन को क़ब्र देखने देगा।
hi.R: तू मुझे मृत्यु के लोक में नहीं छोड़ेगा। जो तेरे प्रति विश्वासयोग्य है, उसे तू क़ब्र में नहीं जाने देगा।

ru.L: Потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не оставишь мою душу в шеоле, не дашь {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} верному увидеть яму.
ru.B: Потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не оставишь меня в мире мёртвых и не позволишь {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} верному увидеть могилу.
ru.R: Ты не оставишь меня в мире мёртвых. Ты не дашь тому, кто верен {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, сойти в могилу.

ja.L: あなたは、わたしの魂を陰府に捨て置くことはなさらず、あなたの誠実な者に穴を見させることはなさらないからである。
ja.B: あなたは、わたしを陰府に見捨てることはなさらず、あなたに誠実な人が滅びの穴を見ることもお許しにならない。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしを死者の世界に置き去りにはなさらない。あなたに忠実な人を、墓に下らせることはなさらない。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не залишиш моєї душі в шеолі; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не даси {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} вірному побачити яму.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не віддаси мене світові мертвих і не допустиш, щоб {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} відданий побачив могилу.
uk.R: Ти не залишиш мене у світі мертвих. Ти не дозволиш тому, хто вірний {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, зійти в могилу.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave
decisions.reason: The word (shachat) means a pit, the grave. The ancient Greek translation took it from a verb meaning to ruin and has "decay", the reading Peter and Paul quote (Acts 2:27, 31; 13:35).

decisions.choice: your faithful one: singular
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is written in a form that could be read as plural, "your faithful ones"; the Hebrew notes and the ancient translations read it as singular, as here. The faithful one (chasid) is the one who is loyal to God (4:4).

decisions.choice: applied to the resurrection of Jesus
decisions.reason: Peter and Paul argue that David died and his body decayed, so these words point beyond him to Jesus, whom God raised (Acts 2:29-31; 13:35-37).

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: As in 3:3, "soul" means the whole person.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:27 and 13:35, with the Hebrew "a cova"
decisions.reason: Peter and Paul quote this verse of Jesus (m4). Each level keeps the Portuguese of Acts 2:27 at the same level: "não abandonarás a minha alma no ... nem deixarás que o teu ... veja" (L), "não me abandonarás no mundo dos mortos, nem permitirás que o teu ..." (B), "Tu não vais me deixar no mundo dos mortos. Não vais deixar que ..." (R). Where the Hebrew differs it is followed: "o Sheol" for Acts' "Hades", and "a cova", "a sepultura" for the pit, where Acts' Greek has "decay" (m2).

decisions.choice: o teu santo (L, B); quem é fiel a ti (R)
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) is one who is loyal to God (m3). Literal and Balanced say "santo", the word Acts 2:27 and 13:35 use ("o teu Santo"), so that the reader sees the verse the apostles quote, in lowercase because the psalm does not make it a title; Readable says what the word means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ታማኝህ" (your faithful one) and "ጉድጓዱ" (the pit, R "መቃብር"), following the Hebrew; "ነፍሴን ወደ ሲኦል አሳልፈህ አትተዋትም" as Acts 2:27 (L)
alternatives: "ቅዱስህ" and "መበስበስ" (your Holy One, decay), as Acts 2:27; 13:35
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ḥasid is the one loyal to God and shaḥat is the pit, the grave (meaning decisions m2, m3); the Greek translation, which Acts follows in applying the verse to the resurrection, has "Holy One" and "decay". Sheol is "ሲኦል" (L), "የሙታን ዓለም" (B, R), as Acts.

decisions.choice: "शिओल" (L), "अधोलोक" (B), "मृत्यु के लोक" (R); "भक्त" (L), "विश्वासयोग्य जन" (B, R) for hasid, as at 4:4; "गड्ढा" (L), "क़ब्र" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:27 quotes this verse and applies it to Jesus' resurrection (m4); its frame is kept at each level. Sheol takes the poetry terms note's forms, which at Balanced and Readable are Acts' own. Acts follows the Greek, "your Holy One" and "decay"; the Hebrew has hasid, the one faithful to God (m3), and the pit, the grave (m2), so the psalm says those.

decisions.choice: "верному" and "яму" (L), "могилу" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the shape and words of Acts 2:27 in this translation ("не оставишь мою душу", "не дашь ... увидеть", "в мире мёртвых"). Acts follows the Greek, "your Holy One" and "decay"; the Hebrew has hasid, the one faithful to God (m3), and shachat, the pit or grave (m2), so the Psalm has "верный" and "яма" / "могила", with Sheol as the poetry note sets it.

decisions.choice: Sheol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R); chasid "誠実な者" (L), "あなたに誠実な人" (B), "あなたに忠実な人" (R); shachat "穴" (L), "滅びの穴" (B), "墓" (R); negatives for God as "〜ことはなさらない" / "お許しにならない"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's forms; a 〜られない negative would read "cannot".

decisions.choice: "яма" (L), "могила" (B, R) for the pit, through the book
decisions.reason: The pit is the grave and the world of the dead; Literal keeps the picture.

source.text: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃

records.literal_gloss: You make known to me [the] path of life; fullness of joys [is] with your face, pleasant [things] at your right hand forever.

en.L: You will make known to me [the] path of life; fullness of joys [is] with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, pleasant [things] at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand forever.
en.B: You teach me the road that leads to life; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence there is joy in full, and at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand delights that never end.
en.R: You show me how to really live. Being near {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fills me with joy. At {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} side there are good things that last forever.

fr.L: Tu me feras connaître [le] sentier de la vie ; plénitude de joies [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, délices à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite pour toujours.
fr.B: Tu m’apprends la route qui mène à la vie ; auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, la joie est complète, et à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite il y a des délices sans fin.
fr.R: Tu me montres comment vivre vraiment. Être près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} me remplit de joie. À {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} côtés, il y a de bonnes choses qui durent toujours.

sw.L: Utanionyesha njia ya uzima; \q wingi wa shangwe [uko] pamoja na uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q mambo matamu katika mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume daima.
sw.B: Unanifundisha barabara inayoelekea uzimani; \q mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kuna furaha kamili, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume kuna raha zisizokwisha.
sw.R: Unanionyesha jinsi ya kuishi kweli. \q Kuwa karibu {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} kunanijaza furaha. \q Kando {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kuna mambo mema yanayodumu milele.

es.L: Tú me darás a conocer [la] senda de la vida; plenitud de gozos [hay] ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, cosas agradables a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha para siempre.
es.B: Tú me enseñas el camino que lleva a la vida; en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia hay alegría completa, y a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} derecha, deleites que nunca terminan.
es.R: Tú me enseñas a vivir de verdad. Estar cerca de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me llena de alegría. A {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lado hay cosas buenas que duran para siempre.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ cho tôi biết con đường sự sống; \q sự trọn vẹn của niềm vui [ở] với mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q những điều vui thích [ở] bên tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời.
vi.B: Ngài dạy tôi con đường dẫn đến sự sống; \q trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có niềm vui trọn vẹn, \q và bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có những điều vui thích không bao giờ dứt.
vi.R: Ngài chỉ cho tôi cách sống thật sự. \q Được ở gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm tôi tràn đầy vui mừng. \q Ở bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có những điều tốt đẹp còn đến mãi mãi.

ko.L: 주님께서 생명의 길을 제게 알려 주실 것입니다. \q 주님의 얼굴 앞에는 기쁨이 충만하고, \q 주님의 오른편에는 영원한 즐거움이 있습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 생명으로 이끄는 길을 제게 가르쳐 주십니다. \q 주님 앞에는 넘치는 기쁨이 있고, \q 주님의 오른편에는 끝없는 즐거움이 있습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 참으로 사는 길을 제게 보여 주십니다. \q 주님 곁에 있으면 저는 기쁨으로 가득 찹니다. \q 주님 곁에는 영원히 이어지는 좋은 것들이 있습니다.

pt.L: Tu me darás a conhecer [o] caminho da vida; plenitude de alegrias [há] com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face, delícias à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} direita para sempre.
pt.B: Tu me ensinas o caminho que leva à vida; estar na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença é alegria completa, e à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} direita há delícias sem fim.
pt.R: Tu me mostras como viver de verdade. Estar perto de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me enche de alegria. Ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} lado há coisas boas que duram para sempre.

am.L: የሕይወትን መንገድ ታሳውቀኛለህ፤ \q በፊትህ የደስታ ሙላት፣ \q በቀኝህም ለዘላለም ተድላ [አለ]።
am.B: ወደ ሕይወት የሚያደርሰውን መንገድ ታስተምረኛለህ፤ \q በፊትህ ሙሉ ደስታ፣ \q በቀኝህም የማያልቅ ተድላ አለ።
am.R: ወደ እውነተኛ ሕይወት የሚወስደውን መንገድ ታሳየኛለህ። \q ከአንተ ጋር መሆኔ በደስታ ይሞላኛል። \q በአንተ አጠገብ ለዘላለም የሚኖሩ መልካም ነገሮች አሉ።

hi.L: तू मुझे जीवन का मार्ग बताएगा; तेरे सम्मुख आनंद की भरपूरी [है], तेरे दाहिने हाथ में सदा सुख [हैं]।
hi.B: तू मुझे जीवन की ओर ले जानेवाला मार्ग सिखाता है; तेरी उपस्थिति में भरपूर आनंद है, और तेरे दाहिने हाथ में ऐसे सुख हैं जो कभी समाप्त नहीं होते।
hi.R: तू मुझे जीवन का मार्ग दिखाता है। तेरे पास रहना मुझे आनंद से भर देता है। तेरे पास ऐसी अच्छी चीज़ें हैं जो सदा बनी रहती हैं।

ru.L: Ты дашь мне познать путь жизни; изобилие радостей — перед {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} лицом, услады — у {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} правой руки навеки.
ru.B: Ты показываешь мне дорогу, ведущую к жизни; рядом с {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} — радость в полноте, а по правую руку от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} — бесконечные услады.
ru.R: Ты показываешь мне путь к настоящей жизни. Рядом с {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} я полон радости. Возле {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} — добро, которое длится вечно.

ja.L: あなたは、わたしに命の道を知らせてくださる。あなたの顔と共に満ちあふれる喜びがあり、あなたの右には、とこしえに楽しみがある。
ja.B: あなたは、命に至る道をわたしに教えてくださる。あなたの前には満ちあふれる喜びがあり、あなたの右には尽きることのない楽しみがある。
ja.R: あなたは、本当に生きる道をわたしに見せてくださる。あなたの近くにいると、わたしは喜びでいっぱいになる。あなたのそばには、いつまでも続く良いものがある。

uk.L: Ти даси мені пізнати стежку життя; повнота радощів — перед {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} обличчям, приємне — у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} правиці навіки.
uk.B: Ти показуєш мені дорогу, що веде до життя; у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} присутності — повнота радості, а праворуч від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} — утіхи, що ніколи не минають.
uk.R: Ти показуєш мені, як справді жити. Бути біля {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} — це радість. Поруч із {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}} — добро, яке триває вічно.

decisions.choice: the path of life: the way that leads to life
decisions.reason: The path of life is the way of living that God shows, which leads away from death (Proverbs 15:24); after verse 10 it is life that death does not end.

decisions.choice: with your face: in your presence
decisions.reason: To be before someone's face is to be in their presence (11:7).

decisions.choice: at your right hand: the place of favor
decisions.reason: The right hand is the place of honor and blessing beside a king (110:1).

decisions.choice: quoted in Acts 2:28
decisions.reason: See verse 8.

decisions.choice: the wording of Acts 2:28 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Acts 2:28 quotes this verse (m4). Each level keeps Acts' Portuguese at the same level: "me ... a conhecer ... caminho da vida" (L), "Tu me ensinas o caminho que leva à vida" (B; Acts "os caminhos que levam à vida"), "o caminho da vida" becoming "como viver de verdade" as the English Readable, and "Estar perto de ti" (R). The Hebrew's second line, "at your right hand forever", which Acts does not quote, is translated as it stands.

decisions.choice: "የሕይወትን መንገድ" (the path of life, singular), and the last line, which Acts 2:28 does not quote, drafted from the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular; the Greek has the plural.

decisions.choice: "जीवन का मार्ग" (L, R), "जीवन की ओर ले जानेवाला मार्ग" (B)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:28 quotes the first half of the verse (m4); its words are kept, with the singular "path" of the Hebrew and its future "you will make known" at Literal. The second half, which Acts does not quote, follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Ты дашь мне познать путь жизни" (L); "дорогу, ведущую к жизни" (B); "путь к ... жизни" (R)
decisions.reason: Acts 2:28 quotes this line (m4); the Psalm keeps the Russian of Acts at each level for the path of life and the joy of God's presence ("рядом с тобой"), with the Hebrew's singular "path" and its last line, which Acts does not quote.
